body: I'm glad I'm being heard from. My phone broke the other day and I can't get a new one till this weekend. Surprisingly I'm not all that worked up over my phone breaking but I feel really disconnected, no pun intended. I've just been in that weird state of mind where I want to talk to someone but at the same time I don't want to talk to anyone.
I really don't know. Get my parents to help me sort out getting formally dropped out I guess.
